notes:
Overview:
- Build shop focused on a VS Code-first code assistant product (extension 'VFW-Suggest').
- Primary differentiator: ultra-low-latency inline suggestions + configurable model pinning per workspace.
- Want streaming completion (token-level updates), ability to pin to model variants for quality/regression control, and quotas per-developer key.

Recent convo highlights:
- CTO (Asha Reddy): "If median suggestion latency >100ms we lose muscle-memory; target 50–80ms end-to-end for single-line completions."
- PM: interested in per-repo routing (open-source -> hosted small model free tier, private repos -> dedicated instances).
- Security: Corporate infosec requires SSO/SAML + KMS integration + audit logs for all generation activity; 90-day retention acceptable.

Technical requirements (from product/eng):
- Streaming via WebSocket or SSE to extension host (they prefer WebSocket for multiplexing).
- Support for continuous prefix/KV caching to avoid recomputing context for repeated edits.
- Model/version pinning at workspace and org levels; must support automatic fallback (e.g., to quantized model variant) during heavy load.
- Rate limits: per-dev and per-org caps; want graceful 429 handling with backoff signals to extension UI.
- Deterministic snippet generation for certain templates (reproducible seeds).

POC notes:
- Demo (02/14): Redwood hosted demo showed 70ms median E2E for single-line suggestions (internal Canary).
- Perf test plan: 2-week dedicated pool POC: 10 concurrent devs, mix of single-line and multi-line completions, 50k tokens/day.
- Acceptance criteria: median latency <90ms, 95th <250ms for single-line, and function-calling reliability >99.5%.

Commercial/context:
- Currently evaluating price sensitivity: prefer usage-based for hosted dev orgs, but want committed reserved capacity for private repos at scale.
- Interested in usage dashboards split by token type (prompt vs completion) and per-route cost.

Quotes & quick notes:
- "We need sane defaults so users on free plan aren't throttled during peak but we can still guarantee SLAs for paid customers." — PM
- Legal asked for sample SLA language and encryption-at-rest detail.

Stubs/links referenced during pipeline:
- Fireflies: ff_20260214_3b9a (initial demo), ff_20260304_7d2f (sec/pm follow-up)
- Drive: PoC deck + security FAQ (links above)

CRM status/logistics:
- AE Samira managing pricing and SOW.
- SE Marcus will run POC instrumentation and coordinate perf scripts.
- No CSM assigned until contract signed.

use_case_summary: VS Code extension that provides streaming inline completions and multi-line code suggestions. Wants workspace/org level model pinning and per-developer rate limits. Priorities: deterministic snippets, low jitter, secure telemetry and audit trail.
requirements: E2E median suggestion latency target 50-90ms for single-line completions
Token-level streaming over WebSocket with immediate patch updates to editor buffer
Workspace/org-level model/version pinning with automatic fallback rules
Per-developer and per-organization rate limits and quota enforcement
Audit logging for every generation call; KMS for encryption-at-rest
VPC option for private repo builds; SSO/SAML for enterprise access
